title: Three-Project Solution Scaffold + IKeychainProvider
keyDecisionsMade: IKeychainProvider.DeleteAsync returns Task (not Task<bool>) as specified in story scope
KeychainProviderFactory.Create(string configDir) takes a non-optional configDir — configDir resolved in Program.cs via EncryptedFileKeychainProvider.GetDefaultConfigDir()
macOS config dir resolved as ~/Library/Application Support/zapi-cli using UserProfile + manual path, not Environment.SpecialFolder.ApplicationData (which gives ~/.config on macOS)
DllImport used instead of LibraryImport for Security.framework P/Invoke — byte[] service/account name params avoid MarshalAs complexity
InMemoryKeychainProvider is thread-safe (uses lock) per story requirement
EncryptedFileKeychainProvider salt is 'zapi-cli' (not 'cliq-cli')
LinuxKeychainProvider sentinel probe key is '__zapi_cli_probe__'
Spectre.Console.Cli 0.49.1 used (same version as cliq-cli)

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: Used SHA256(MachineName + MachineGuid + 'zapi-cli') as AES-256 key. IV is first 12 bytes of .bin file, then ciphertext, then 16-byte GCM tag. MachineGuid: ioreg on macOS, HKLM registry on Windows, /etc/machine-id on Linux.
LinuxKeychainProvider.TryCreate() catches DllNotFoundException and any other error. Performs sentinel probe on init. Returns false to signal fallback to EncryptedFileKeychainProvider.

title: Output Contract + Error Infrastructure + Global Settings
keyDecisionsMade: ErrorCodes uses 'static readonly string' fields with SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE names (ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND etc.) as specified in story, not PascalCase like cliq-cli
IOutputWriter has WriteJson (no envelope wrapper, serializes directly), WriteRaw (verbatim passthrough), WriteError (to stderr) — differs from cliq-cli's WriteSuccess wrapper
InMemoryOutputWriter.ErrorRecord is a nested sealed record exposing Message, Code, ExitCode for clean test assertions
OutputJsonOptions is an internal static class in JsonOutputWriter.cs — shared by InMemoryOutputWriter via same ZapiCli.Core namespace
ErrorEnvelope uses [JsonPropertyName] attributes to override SnakeCaseLower: 'error', 'code', 'exitCode' (camelCase, not 'exit_code')
Exception handling uses config.SetExceptionHandler (Spectre pattern) rather than try/catch around RunAsync
Microsoft.Extensions.Http added to ZapiCli.csproj for services.AddHttpClient()
Microsoft.Extensions.Logging + Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console added to ZapiCli.Core.csproj per story spec

title: AccountStore + OAuthProvider + ZohoCorp Block + DcResolver
keyDecisionsMade: AccountStore constructor takes (string configDir, ILogger<AccountStore>) — no production parameterless constructor; configDir injected from Program.cs via EncryptedFileKeychainProvider.GetDefaultConfigDir(), avoiding cross-project dependency
OAuthCredentials uses camelCase JsonSerializerOptions (JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase) for keychain blob — distinct from SnakeCaseLower options for user-visible output (OQ-002)
AccountEntry.Zuid annotated with [JsonPropertyName("zuidstring")] to match Zoho API convention
ZohoCorpGuard is internal static class in ZapiCli.Core.Security namespace — never exposed to ZapiCli layer
DcResolver is internal static class in ZapiCli.Core.Auth namespace — maps 9 dc short names to Zoho Accounts base URLs
OAuthProvider.RefreshTokenAsync uses form-encoded POST to DcResolver.GetAccountsBaseUrl(dc)+'/oauth/v2/token' per OQ-003
Microsoft.Extensions.Http 10.0.0 added to ZapiCli.Core.csproj for IHttpClientFactory injection in OAuthProvider
AccountStore on Unix: File.SetUnixFileMode with UserRead|UserWrite (0600) after SaveAsync
AccountStore on Windows: FileSecurity + FileSystemAccessRule FullControl for current user, wrapped in try/catch with LogWarning fallback (OQ-007)

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: Keychain blob uses camelCase JSON: { "accessToken": "...", "clientId": "...", "clientSecret": "..." }. OAuthCredentials deserialized with CamelCase JsonSerializerOptions.
RefreshTokenAsync: form-encoded POST to <dcBaseUrl>/oauth/v2/token with grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=...&client_secret=...&scope=<comma-joined>. Parses 'access_token' from JSON response.

Windows ACL: FileSecurity with SetAccessRuleProtection(isProtected:true, preserveInheritance:false) + FileSystemAccessRule(currentUser, FullControl, Allow). Wrapped in try/catch; logs warning on failure, does not abort SaveAsync.

issuesEncountered.issue: Test file missing 'using ZapiCli.Keychain' causing CS0246 for IKeychainProvider in FakeHttpClientFactory

title: Account Command Group (add, list, remove, show, set-default, re-auth)
keyDecisionsMade: Business logic extracted to IAccountService/AccountService in ZapiCli.Core per ADR-0007 'no business logic in ZapiCli' rule. Command classes are thin delegates.

AccountAddSettings.Validate() throws CommandRuntimeException via Spectre internals; added 'is CommandRuntimeException → INVALID_ARGS' handler in Program.cs SetExceptionHandler to emit correct JSON error code.
AccountListView has no Token property by design — compile-time guarantee that no token reaches output. AccountShowView.Token is unconditionally '***'.
ZohoCorp block runs AFTER user-info fetch (to obtain email) but BEFORE any keychain write or accounts.json mutation — step order enforced in AccountService.AddAccountAsync.
Token revocation in RemoveAccountAsync is best-effort: wrapped in try/catch; logs warning on failure but always continues with local cleanup.
FakeHttpClientFactory in tests ignores the 'name' parameter and returns the same HttpClient for all CreateClient() calls — sufficient for unit testing.
InternalsVisibleTo(ZapiCli.Tests) added to ZapiCli.csproj to enable unit testing of internal AccountCommands.AccountAddSettings.Validate().
ZapiCli.Tests.csproj now references ZapiCli (the CLI exe project) to allow testing command settings classes.

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: Used { 'status':'ok', 'data':{ 'name':'<name>', 'dc':'<dc>' } } envelope as authoritative output for account add per defaultAssumption. Same wrapper for remove/set-default/re-auth.
GET {baseUrl}/oauth/user/info with Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken <token>. Parses 'Email' and 'ZPUID' fields. Missing email → EMAIL_REQUIRED exit 1.
POST {baseUrl}/oauth/v2/token/revoke with form body token=<access_token>. Non-200 response → log warning and continue local cleanup.

issuesEncountered.issue: Spectre CommandRuntimeException (from Validate() failure) was falling through to the INTERNAL_ERROR handler
issuesEncountered.resolution: Added explicit 'is Spectre.Console.Cli.CommandRuntimeException → INVALID_ARGS' branch in Program.cs SetExceptionHandler, placed before the generic handler.

title: ApiClient + api call Command
keyDecisionsMade: IOutputWriter omitted from ApiClient constructor — the story spec listed it but ApiClient has no output responsibility; commands write via IOutputWriter. Omitting it prevents CS0169/IDE0052 warnings. Output is always handled by ApiCallCommand.
AllowedHostSuffixes is a private static readonly string[] — NOT a const array (arrays cannot be const in C#), but is compile-time fixed and has no runtime override path (ADR-0004).
ValidateHost is marked internal (not private) to allow direct unit testing in ZapiCli.Tests via InternalsVisibleTo — avoids testing entire CallAsync for pure suffix-check scenarios.

HttpClient lifetime: stored in IHttpClientFactory and retrieved via CreateClient('zapi-api') — never disposed by ApiClient (IHttpClientFactory manages handler lifetime). Named client registered with 30s timeout.

Query parameter encoding uses Uri.EscapeDataString + UriBuilder instead of System.Web.HttpUtility.ParseQueryString — avoids any potential cross-platform System.Web concerns while being functionally equivalent.
Content-Type auto-injection: StringContent is created with 'application/json' as default media type; caller can override via --header 'Content-Type:...' which is applied before body construction.

NeedsReauth flow: after RefreshTokenAsync, LoadAsync + mutate root + SaveAsync pattern persists the updated NeedsReauth=false. Re-fetch of account after NeedsReauth clear ensures any concurrent changes are respected.
FakeAuthProvider.SetToken convenience method added for unit test ergonomics.
FakeAccountStore added to ZapiCli.Tests/Fakes/ as a simple in-memory IAccountStore for ApiClient unit tests.

issuesEncountered.issue: ApiCommands.cs compiled without 'using Spectre.Console' — ValidationResult is in Spectre.Console namespace, not Spectre.Console.Cli
issuesEncountered.resolution: Added 'using Spectre.Console;' to the top of ApiCommands.cs

title: Utility Commands (util time-ms, util uuid, util time-now)
keyDecisionsMade: All command classes live in a single static class UtilCommands in UtilCommands.cs — consistent with the ApiCommands and AccountCommands pattern.
CommandContext parameter passed as null! in unit tests — Spectre's CommandContext has no public constructor useful for testing and these commands don't use context.
WriteJson called with anonymous objects { ts }, { uuid }, and { now } — SnakeCaseLower serializer renders keys correctly without any [JsonPropertyName] override.
util time-now uses TimeZoneInfo.CreateCustomTimeZone with a fixed +05:30 offset (IST) — avoids OS timezone database dependency, fully cross-platform.
util time-now format is 'dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss.fff' — 24-hour clock with 3-digit milliseconds. Example: 20/03/26 21:15:30.427.
IST TimeZoneInfo instance declared as a private static readonly field on UtilCommands — shared across all UtilTimeNowCommand invocations.

title: Browser OAuth Infrastructure: LocalCallbackServer + IOAuthBrowserFlow/OAuthBrowserFlow + ErrorCodes
keyDecisionsMade: HttpListener prefix changed from /callback/ to / (root) — HttpListener prefix /callback/ does NOT match requests to /callback?query=string (no trailing slash path). Using / as prefix matches all requests on the ephemeral port, which is safe since we own it exclusively.

Tests use UseProxy=false in HttpClientHandler — a corporate Squid proxy at 127.0.0.1:3128 intercepts localhost HTTP requests and returns 503. Production browser OAuth redirects skip the proxy (browsers bypass proxy for localhost natively). Only tests need UseProxy=false.
OperatingSystem.IsMacOS/IsLinux/IsWindows() used for platform detection in OAuthBrowserFlow (not RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform) to satisfy CA1416 with TreatWarningsAsErrors=true.
TOCTOU retry logic in LocalCallbackServer constructor: catches HttpListenerException on first Start(), retries once with new ephemeral port.
OAuthBrowserFlow.OpenBrowser always prints URL to Console.Error before Process.Start — visible even in piped output, serves as manual-paste fallback.

issuesEncountered.issue: HttpListener prefix http://localhost:{port}/callback/ does not match OAuth redirect URL /callback?code=...&state=... (path /callback without slash)
issuesEncountered.resolution: Changed prefix to http://localhost:{port}/ (root prefix) — matches all requests on the ephemeral port. Since we own this port exclusively, no ambiguity.

issuesEncountered.issue: Tests timed out with LOGIN_TIMEOUT — corporate Squid proxy at 127.0.0.1:3128 intercepted localhost HTTP requests and returned 503 before HttpListener received them
issuesEncountered.resolution: Updated LocalCallbackServer test HttpClient to use new HttpClientHandler { UseProxy = false }. Production code unaffected (real browser bypasses proxy for localhost).

stateAfterStory.tests: 94 passing, 1 pre-existing failure (AccountStore_ZuidSerializesAsZuidstring — unrelated to Story 10)

title: Trace System + trace session Commands

filesCreatedOrModified.action: modified — inject ITraceWriter, capture trace info, write entry after each api call
modified — register trace services + trace command branches

keyDecisionsMade: ApiTraceEntry.Session and ApiTraceEntry.SessionId are NOT 'required' — default to empty string. ApiClient builds entry without these; TraceWriter fills them from the active session via GetActiveSessionAsync.
ApiClient injects ITraceWriter only (not ITraceSession) — TraceWriter handles all session lookups internally. Clean separation: ApiClient provides HTTP data, TraceWriter owns session awareness.

Named Mutex for cross-process safety: on Windows 'Global\zapi-cli-trace-{uuid}', on macOS/Linux 'zapi-cli-trace-{uuid}' (no Global\ prefix — backslash invalid in POSIX semaphore names). RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform used for conditional naming.

Mutex + synchronous I/O via Task.Run wrapping: IncrementEntryCountAsync, UpdateStatusSync (for close/reopen) run sync file I/O inside Task.Run to avoid async/await thread-affinity violation with thread-affine Mutex.
IncrementEntryCountAsync returns -1 on Mutex timeout or session-not-found — TraceWriter checks for seq <= 0 and drops the entry silently with a LogWarning. No exception thrown for timeout.

ITraceSession.StartSessionAsync takes string? requestedExportPath (nullable) — export path resolution (including default config read) happens inside TraceSession.StartSessionAsync. Command stays thin: passes settings.ExportPath directly.

Export path resolution: ends-with-.json → use as exact file path; directory (or null with default configured) → <name>-<uuid[0..8]>.json using first 8 chars of UUID after removing dashes. UUID short-id: sessionId.Replace('-','')[..8].
TraceExporter uses synchronous File.ReadLines (not async) for simplicity — trace files are typically small.

Header key case preservation: Dictionary<string,string> keys are serialized with their original case by System.Text.Json (PolicyNamingPolicy does not apply to dict keys). Unit tests use case-insensitive EnumerateObject() helpers.

TraceWriter.AppendApiEntryAsync is awaited synchronously in ApiClient.CallAsync (not fire-and-forget) to satisfy the 'writes immediately' AC. Uses CancellationToken.None so a ctrl-C after the call still allows the entry to flush.

Sessions.json root is TraceSessionsRoot (inner private class in TraceSession) with List<TraceSessionEntry> Sessions. Serialized with OutputJsonOptions.Shared (SnakeCaseLower) so file keys match CLI output.

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: Name validation: [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], max 64 chars. Regex: @"^[a-zA-Z0-9_.\"-]{1,64}$". No uniqueness check. SESSION_AMBIGUOUS on export/close/reopen/remove by --name when multiple match.
Named Mutex keyed by UUID. WaitOne(2000) — -1 returned on timeout. Task.Run wrapping to avoid async/await thread-affinity issue with Mutex.

Status-based drain: CloseSessionAsync sets 'closing' (step 1), waits waitMs, sets 'closed' (step 3). Both under Mutex. TraceWriter drops entry silently when status='closing' or session is null (closed).
EntryCount NOT reset on reopen. ReopenSessionAsync only changes status to 'active'. IncrementEntryCount reads current EntryCount and increments — seq continues from where it left off.
RemoveSessionAsync removes only the sessions.json entry. Trace file at ExportPath is preserved by design.
Export file name when path is a directory: '<name>-<shortId>.json' where shortId = sessionId.Replace('-','')[..8].
